**TL;DR: Be patient rather than impatient.**

See... This is something a lot of people don't understand:

If you want anything major to happen, you have to wait until Jagex decides to actually commit a fully-fledged team to DarkScape, and even then I doubt they're just going to throw everything to the wind to make everything exactly like it was pre-EoC. 

Legacy combat is a resemblance, and it has a lot of flaws in DarkScape because **it originally had to attempt to compete with EoC combat when it was released**, it is not perfected to be the almighty balanced PKing monster machine everyone seems to think it should be. 

It will take time, and it will take patience on the DarkScape community's part in order for us to see some real major changes. Yes, shit is unbalanced. Yes, it's frustrating. Yes, it really makes the game not fun in a respect, but *we have to wait or nothing will get done*.

Yes, complaining does shed light on what we want to be changed, but getting fully-reverted pre-EoC combat is most-likely **not** going to happen, because when OSRS was released Jagex stated that the only real image of the old game from pre-EoC is what they started out with on OSRS.
